## Verification status

Every record carries a status. Promotion to `verified` requires inspecting the canonical source.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ verified | Canonical repository/source inspected and core description grounded in it. |
| 🧪 candidate | Discovered but not sufficiently validated. |
| 🗄️ archival | Historical/inactive but still useful. |
| ⛔ rejected | Could not be substantiated or was materially misleading. |

## Adding or changing a record

1. Edit the JSON file, keeping `id` stable and dates in ISO format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
2. Run `python scripts/validate_catalog.py` to check the record.
3. Run `python scripts/render.py` to refresh the README, docs and folder pages.
4. Open a pull request with the canonical source and the claims you checked.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the verification rules.
